name: Hennef (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Hennef (a white castle with a small shield on red).
history: Municipal flag of Hennef; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hennef arms — white castle on red
